product_brief: Server platform with enhanced silicon root of trust and iLO7 firmware using quantum-resistant algorithms for secure boot and firmware authentication.
pqc_capability_description: HPE ProLiant Compute Gen12 features an enhanced silicon root of trust using quantum-resistant algorithms. iLO7 firmware flash updates are signed and authenticated using a CNSA 2.0 approved algorithm. iLO7 can authenticate other firmware updates signed with quantum-resistant algorithms.
crypto_primitives: CNSA 2.0 approved algorithm (specific primitive name not stated)
pqc_roadmap_details: Aligning with CNSA 2.0 timelines; integrating quantum-resistant algorithms for firmware signing and authentication.
signature_schemes: CNSA 2.0 approved algorithm (specific scheme name not stated)

product_name: HP 8000 Series printers (HP Color LaserJet Enterprise MFP 8801, Mono MFP 8601, and LaserJet Pro Mono SFP 8501)
product_brief: World's first printers with quantum-resistant cryptography to protect firmware integrity against quantum attacks.
pqc_capability_description: Designed with quantum resilience using new ASIC chips that enable digital signature verification to protect firmware integrity against quantum attacks. Includes post-quantum digital signature and initial BIOS firmware integrity protection with automatic self-healing recovery.
pqc_roadmap_details: Designed to meet US government’s 2027 migration timeline for National Security Systems requiring quantum-resistant cryptographic code signing.
